title: Season 1 · Extras
lede: Between the circles: the Devcon 8 session the proposal grew out of, the one-year video, a hug, the frame walkthrough and the first five how-to-play cards. Public already, credited, consent on every piece. Drafts that still wait for Shaka's bless are not here.
rule: Only pieces that are already public go on this shelf. Synthetic voices say so. Takedown first.

items.title: In the future music and culture is free
items.subtitle: Devcon 8 · Jasmine Stage 4 · Mumbai
items.blurb: The Devcon 8 session where Alaska, Tomo and Shaka talked about a future in which music and culture are free — the room the Open Source Orchestra proposal grew out of. A public Devcon recording, loaded only when you choose, privacy-enhanced.
items.credit: Recorded and published by Devcon (Ethereum Foundation) on the Devcon YouTube channel.

consent.line: Published by Devcon as part of the public Devcon 8 programme. Shaka's own words from it may be quoted verbatim; the other speakers' words are paraphrased until they say yes.

links.label: Shaka's speaker page · the session and his words

items.title: Open Source Orchestra Frames · a 49-second walkthrough
items.subtitle: how every door wears the same frame
items.blurb: The frame around every Open Source Orchestra door, shown in 49 seconds: the rails, the door pill, the globe, the ⋯ menu, and the ✕ that folds anything away so nothing ever covers the words.
items.credit: Filmed by the AI ʻohana on the live doors; CC0 music bed; captions included. Code GPL-3.0 · film CC BY-SA 4.0.

consent.line: Screen recording of our own public doors; no people in it.
